title: How Many Dragons to BEAT a Chess YouTuber? (feat. two niche)
summary: Odds challenge on PyChess vs chess YouTuber TwoNiche (webcam, disguised as '100 Elo Chad' / 'Goopy Chadson'): iwantcheckmate has a king plus N dragons (knight + bishop) against a full army, adding one dragon each game until he wins. 1 dragon: threefold draw (doesn't count); 2 dragons: win; courtesy 3-dragon game: win.
rules: White starts with King + 1 Dragon; one dragon is added each game that is not a win (0:01, 3:49: a draw does not count).
Dragon = moves like a knight and a bishop (0:01).
Black has a full standard army; otherwise standard chess, 5+0 clock (frames).
PyChess does not flag threefold in some variants; the video treats the repetition as a draw (3:26).
